results.title: Lo único que te Pido
results.overview: With only two months left to live, Sofía makes one final, unexpected request: to spend an intimate night with her former lover. Determined to fulfill her wish, her devoted husband Ángel sets out to find the man, who has been missing since 2002. What follows is an outrageous journey filled with deception, unexpected complications, and increasingly absurd situations that challenge the boundaries of love, loyalty, and marriage.

results.title: Blade
results.overview: Sophie, a vulnerable teenage girl caught in a cycle of emotional validation and humiliation by a boy who objectifies her, blurs the line between fantasy and reality as her longing for affection begins to consume her sense of self.

results.title: Only Me
results.overview: A disoriented man wakes up in a car in the middle of nowhere, with a gun, a cryptic note and a bound woman. As events unfold, he is drawn into the disturbing world of a Mumbai model whose carefully constructed rituals blur the lines between victim and predator. Through violence, deception and haunting memories, the film explores trauma, control and the struggle to reclaim one's agency.

results.title: The Property
results.overview: When two desperate university students, Timothy and Bryce, answer a Craigslist ad in the country for a sum of cash, their seemingly odd host shifts into something far more sinister, threatening their lives.

results.title: The Alienist
results.overview: A small-town psychiatrist loses the sight of distinction between sanity and insanity, beginning to commit anyone.

results.title: Aarambham Oru Albaniyo Katha
results.overview: Four unemployed graduates from Bethoorpara, North Kerala, face ridicule from family and society. When they finally land a job, it brings unexpected trouble, forcing them into a desperate struggle to escape.

results.title: Mucker
results.overview: Mucker provides a fascinating insight into the professional and personal life of the pioneering and award winning British documentary film maker Brian Moser.

results.title: Abegar 2026
results.overview: prepared and presented by Nigussu Film Production

results.title: The Sound We Make Together
results.overview: Striving for fame, is that the right reason to be head over heels in the competitive music industry? It's no secret that the music industry is one of the toughest out there…creative slumps, isolation, the fear of 'not making it' and failure. So, we introduce The Hills Brothers, a brotherly duo of musicians, local to Portsmouth, who spend their nights hosting several Open Mic nights all over Portsmouth and Hampshire. Take a deeper look into why they find these Open Mic nights more than just a fun night to express yourself and your music. Understand why these nights create a community for musicians and why venues like Casemates are essential for the artists support.

results.title: Olivia Rodrigo: Austin City Limits
results.overview: GRAMMY Award-Winning Multi-Platinum ‪Olivia Rodrigo‬ Takes the ACL Stage Five Years After Her Debut with First Full-Set Performance of Chart-Topping Album "you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love".

results.title: Transfigurations (An American Gothic)
results.overview: Charlie Hastings, after vanishing during the Summer of 1993, returns home two years later. His parents, Maggie and Forest, must decide if this homecoming is a miracle or an omen.

results.title: Burning in Dreams
results.overview: Memories of dreams are like a piece of paper filled with words in our minds, leaving only burnt fragments upon waking. If these memory snippets are edited together, would it be a documentary of nightmares? Or a stream-of-consciousness short film akin to collage art?

results.title: Syekh Yusuf Al-Makassari: In The Blessing of Ceylon
results.original_title: Syekh Yusuf Al-Makassari: In The Blessing of Ceylon
results.overview: From the Indonesian archipelago to Ceylon and beyond, Syekh Yusuf’s journey is a story of knowledge, faith, resilience, and connections that crossed borders and generations. His legacy continues to connect the histories and cultures of Indonesia and the wider Indian Ocean world.

results.title: The Perfect Soup
results.overview: Roommates, Todd and Linda go on a series of dates. Only to realize love might be closer than they think.

results.title: Dhanushkodiyilekku
results.overview: The starkly different lives of two families intertwine across decades of shifting history. While one group barely survived the catastrophic 1964 Dhanushkodi cyclone, the other has only ever known immense wealth.

results.title: Center Stage for Murder
results.overview: After suffering a tragic accident, a ballerina finds safety, comfort and intimacy in the arms of her physical therapist. However, she soon becomes a prisoner in her own home when she discovers he's the one responsible for her injury.
